official_title: Draft Commission Guidelines on the classification of high-risk AI systems
short_title: Draft high-risk classification guidelines — Complete consultation work

institution_roles.evidence_locator: PDF page 1 cover carries the European Commission masthead; the official library identifies this file as one section of the complete draft guidelines work.

corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: Complete Commission consultation work jointly published through three official section downloads interpreting the AI Act's high-risk classification rules.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: This record represents the real complete consultation work published by the Commission library through three separately downloadable sections. It is not the prospective numbered Commission communication shown only as a placeholder on the draft covers. The library supplies the work-level publication date and section structure; the three PDFs supply the complete work's substantive, sector, authorship and draft-status evidence. No cover placeholder is treated as a reference or adoption date.
